name: Grape Stomper OG - Infused Ice Packs (Rosin, Hash, and Diamonds) 5x 0.5g
description: Rove Ice Packs, the world’s first triple-infused preroll. Made with premium-grade flower fully-infused with THCA diamonds and solventless ice hash rosin, they're expertly rolled, then coated with more ice hash. Super smooth and ultra potent, Rove Ice Packs test at over 50% THC. Welcome to the next evolution of prerolls. Drift into tranquility with Grape Stomper, a soothing indica preroll that gently merges mind and body. This carefully crafted blend slowly unwinds tension, easing your mind into a dreamy haze. Perfect for when you need to unplug and drift off.
